scope: Independent technical-art acceptance protocol for a future Phase4 v8 visual-style targeted11 capture. It preserves all frozen ownership, threshold, route, offset, z-order, camera, layout, scene, and evidence semantics.

independent_frozen_evidence_review.method: Both frozen PPMs were decoded losslessly and inspected individually at their original 1920x1080 physical resolution; telemetry was treated as authoritative for probe ownership and final-LDR failure reasons.

ordinal1.regression_risk: The larger player-low projection keeps predicted core, halo, dash rhythm, endpoint, and much of the actual track readable. A later style change must not collapse these distinctions or reduce the authoritative ordinal1 machine result.

ordinal2.visual_finding: At elevated scale the predicted and actual tracks occupy the same narrow screen-space band. Predicted core/halo/dash structure becomes fragile across dark surround, teal cloth, red balls, and the ball cluster; the actual near-white segment and endpoint can merge with pale ball surfaces and the predicted dash gap.
ordinal2.telemetry_finding: Seven predicted outer-halo probes fail final edge contrast, one predicted outer-halo probe and one predicted core probe fail owned area, and one actual solid-in-predicted-dash-gap probe fails final edge contrast against a pale background. Ownership, association, foreign-track, unowned, and double-assignment defects are zero.

canonical_ta_axes.acceptance: The predicted track remains continuously identifiable as predicted, independently of hue, across every visible background transition.
The actual track remains continuously identifiable as actual and visually distinct from predicted, including near-white ball surfaces.
Core and inner/outer halo layers remain separately readable without merging, inversion, or one role erasing the other.
The final-LDR outer silhouette remains readable against deep dark, teal cloth, red ball, and near-white ball-surface adjacencies.
Predicted dash units and gaps remain rhythmically separable; actual solid pixels in a predicted gap do not read as a predicted dash or close the gap.
Predicted and actual endpoints/ticks remain visible, attached to the correct track, and distinguishable from balls, halos, and each other.
Where predicted and actual are co-axial or nearly co-axial, both tracks and their core/halo/dash/endpoint roles remain independently traceable.

ordinal2_blocking_axes.frozen_basis: Seven predicted outer-halo final-edge-contrast failures across dark, teal, and red adjacencies.
ordinal2_blocking_axes.future_pass_condition: No predicted outer silhouette is visually lost or confused across the required stress contexts, and the unchanged authoritative machine gate passes.

ordinal2_blocking_axes.frozen_basis: One predicted outer-halo and one predicted core owned-area failure at the tight co-axial cluster.
ordinal2_blocking_axes.future_pass_condition: Core and halo remain independently readable at the frozen co-axial projection without threshold, geometry, offset, z-order, camera, or layout changes.

ordinal2_blocking_axes.frozen_basis: One actual solid-in-predicted-dash-gap final-edge-contrast failure against near-white adjacency.
ordinal2_blocking_axes.future_pass_condition: Actual remains identifiable against the near-white surface while the predicted gap remains visibly open and semantically predicted.

ordinal2_blocking_axes.frozen_basis: All 12 actual candidates lie within 12 physical pixels of predicted candidates in the valid elevated stress projection.
ordinal2_blocking_axes.future_pass_condition: A reviewer can trace predicted and actual independently through overlap without relying on spatial displacement or changed ordering.

ordinal2_blocking_axes.frozen_basis: Endpoint/tick roles machine-pass in the frozen payload but are mandatory visual regression controls at elevated scale.
ordinal2_blocking_axes.future_pass_condition: Both endpoints and all visible ticks remain attached, role-readable, and unconfused with balls or halo intersections.

future_targeted11_machine_prerequisite.stable_evidence_aggregate_algorithm: SHA256 over exact ordinal order of capture_id + NUL + ppm_sha256 + NUL + telemetry_sha256 + LF

future_independent_ta_protocol.reviewer: Independent technical-art reviewer who did not implement the visual-style correction.
method: First validate a frozen future targeted11 machine receipt with 11/11 PASS and exact per-case PPM/telemetry bindings.
Open every PPM individually at its exact physical dimensions; thumbnails, contact sheets, machine crops, and aggregate metrics are not substitutes.
Judge all seven canonical axes on every image and record PASS or FAIL with image-specific observations and coordinates.
Across the complete set, separately judge all six roles in all five stress contexts; each context-role cell needs a bound case ID and physical coordinate evidence.
Re-review ordinal1 independently as a regression control and ordinal2 independently against all five blocking axes.
Any NOT_RUN, missing evidence, failed machine case, failed image axis, failed stress cell, failed ordinal1 regression, or remaining ordinal2 blocker makes overall TA acceptance unavailable or FAIL.

forbidden_workarounds: No probe inventory, denominator, route, offset, or trajectory change.
No z-order, camera preset/pose, projection, viewport, UI scale, table, ball, asset, scene, or layout change.
No ownership, association, arbitration, hidden-reason, semantic track identity, or source-probe algorithm change.
No cropping, selective omission, enlarged-only review, post-process repaint, or machine-only substitution for original-resolution TA review.
